name: Harta
subtitle: Your places. Your way.
promotional_text: Find your next stop, save the places you love, and share your map with family. Walking, cycling, and driving directions keep the journey simple.
description:
Keep your favourite places close.

Harta brings maps, saved places, and directions together in a clear, simple app for iPhone and iPad.

MAKE YOUR MAP YOUR OWN
Save a search result or drop a pin anywhere on the map. Give saved places a name, choose a symbol and colour, and find them again from the map, saved list, or search.

FIND YOUR NEXT STOP
Search for places by typing or speaking. Saved destinations appear alongside online results, so the places you already know are easy to find.

CHOOSE YOUR WAY THERE
Get walking, cycling, or driving directions. Start turn-by-turn navigation and enable spoken guidance when you want it.

SEE WHAT MATTERS
Choose Quiet, Everyday, Walking, or Explore map styles. Add layers for cycling paths, transit, parking, EV chargers, toilets, and everyday essentials. Light and dark appearances follow your device.

SHARE PLACES WITH FAMILY
Invite people to view your saved map through iCloud. You own and edit the map; invited members see your places and later changes. Their personal saved places stay separate. Sharing is about saved destinations: live location and recent searches are not shared.

ON-DEVICE VOICE SEARCH
Speech recognition runs on your device. Voice audio and transcripts are not saved. Unmatched destination searches use the same online search service as typed queries.

Harta requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. Maps, search, and routing need an internet connection. Downloaded saved places remain available offline. Family map sharing requires an active iCloud account for each participant, and maps sync while Harta is open. Map coverage and speech feature availability vary. Offline routing and live traffic are not available.
whats_new: Share saved places with family through iCloud, personalise place icons and colours, and touch and hold a saved place’s name to rename it.
